candidates.authorityName: California Department of Fish and Wildlife

parameters.note: Baker Creek is not listed in CCR §7.40(b) or §7.50(b), so it falls under the general statewide stream regulation in §5.85(a)(2): open with a five-trout bag from the last Saturday in April through November 15, then a zero-trout catch-and-release period with gear restrictions from November 16 through the Friday preceding the last Saturday in April.

end.verbatim: the Friday preceding the last Saturday in April

candidates.summary: Open the last Saturday in April through November 15 (general statewide stream regulation); November 16 through the Friday preceding the last Saturday in April is a zero-trout, artificial-lures-with-barbless-hooks period

candidates.authorityName: California Department of Fish and Wildlife

parameters.counting_rule: General statewide trout limit for inland streams, rivers, and canals: five-trout daily bag limit and ten-trout possession limit, in effect from the last Saturday in April through November 15.

candidates.summary: 5 trout daily bag limit, 10 trout possession limit, last Saturday in April through November 15

candidates.authorityName: California Department of Fish and Wildlife

parameters.counting_rule: Zero-trout bag limit from November 16 through the Friday preceding the last Saturday in April; trout must be released unharmed and should not be removed from the water.

candidates.summary: Zero-trout bag limit (catch-and-release for trout), November 16 through the Friday preceding the last Saturday in April

candidates.authorityName: California Department of Fish and Wildlife

parameters.note: Gear restriction applies from November 16 through the Friday preceding the last Saturday in April, for all species of fish. During the regular season (last Saturday in April through November 15) the general stream regulation imposes no gear restrictions.

candidates.summary: Only artificial lures with barbless hooks may be used from November 16 through the Friday preceding the last Saturday in April

candidates.authorityName: California Department of Fish and Wildlife

parameters.note: Anglers 16 years of age or older must have a valid California sport fishing license.

candidates.summary: California sport fishing license required for anglers 16+

schedule.note: CDFW's 2026 Provisional Stocking Document for Trout and Inland Salmon lists Baker Creek (Region 5, Inyo Co.) for catchable-size Rainbow Trout under the Put and Take program, with a stated release month range of April-November. This is CDFW's provisional plan for 2026, not a guaranteed annual constant.
